summary: A proposal for {design} gets no second on its own and then passes as part of a set.
realLife: John Saunders could not get a second on a shared World Cup reverse alone, but Arthur Bernstein included it with three fronts in a package that passed. The chair reported to Treasury that the selected clad front had tied with two other drawings.
gates: The same reverse could serve several coins whose fronts are ready for review.
inGame: needs: individual motion and later package vote.

turns.what: A second member backs taking up the reverse separately.
turns.pulledBy: Another member wants that decision settled first.
turns.writesBack: The common back gets a separate vote.

turns.what: One disputed front holds up the whole package.
turns.pulledBy: Members vote to set that drawing aside before taking up the rest.
turns.writesBack: The minutes show which designs still await action.
